goal: Update a member's mailing address in the member-service application. Find the member, open their record, change the mailing address to the supplied one, review the change, obtain approval, submit it, then confirm the update was actually stored and report the confirmation identifier the application issues.

member_id.description: The member's identifier, in the form M-0000. Search accepts it directly.

address.description: The new mailing address, one value per form field.

line2.description: Apartment or suite, may be empty

confirmation_id.description: The confirmation identifier shown after a successful submission
